name: @kkutysllb/dsh-git-panel
description: dsh-external in-box dsh bundle: standalone git workspace panel as an independent right-side floating panel. v0.5.0 adds a Codex-style environment section (change file list, work-location/worktree switch, branch picker with create+checkout, commit or push, compare-branch external link) on top of change stats + task plans; plan documents previewed through dsh-better-sidebar when present.
